note: Subject layer (layer 5) for the ORIGINAL (Human) faction. Keys are runtime art subjects from src/assets/chibi-art-v7.ts. Batch beads add and refine subjects here; the roster notes in docs/art/factions/ORIGINAL.md give each role's distinguishing silhouette.

subjects.UNIT:FIGHTER: Subject: Fighter, a chunky cute sword warrior with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body: round light steel-grey helmet with a big bright red crest, oversized light steel short sword held up in the right hand, big round shield of plain light grey steel with a darker steel rim and boss held on the left arm in front of the body, bright red tunic covering the torso, light grey gloves, dark slate-grey boots; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:MARKSMAN: Subject: Marksman, a basic archer with a very big head (about half of the figure's height) and a tiny sturdy body: big bright red pointed hood over the head and shoulders showing the face, no helmet under the hood, big tall longbow of pale yellow birch wood held upright in the left hand, a pale tan quiver of white-feathered arrows on the back, long bright red tunic down to the knees, cream-white sleeves and trousers, light grey gloves, dark slate-grey boots and belt; no shield, no sword, no helmet, no brown leather; clearly different from a sword fighter.
subjects.CITY:1: Subject: a small level-1 town: one short round beige cobblestone tower with a bright red cone roof and a big red banner flag, and three chunky cottages with cream plaster walls and solid bright red tile roofs pressed around its foot; no wall; wide and chunky, filling the whole width of the image.
subjects.CITY:2: Subject: a level-2 town with no people, clearly bigger than a small town: five chunky cottages with cream plaster walls and solid bright red tile roofs packed around a tall square beige cobblestone keep with a big red banner flag, a beige cobblestone wall across the front with a gate and one round beige corner tower with a bright red cone roof; wide and chunky, filling the whole width of the image.
subjects.CITY:3: Subject: a large level-3 city, the biggest settlement: many chunky houses with cream plaster walls and bright red tile roofs packed inside a crenellated grey stone ring wall with a gate, two round grey stone corner towers with bright red cone roofs and a tall central keep with a big red banner flag; wide and chunky, filling the whole image.
subjects.SITE:VILLAGE: Subject: a tiny neutral hamlet: two or three small round cottages with cream plaster walls on beige cobblestone footings and golden-yellow straw thatched roofs, a short pale wooden fence; no flag, no banner, no tower, no stone wall, and no red or orange anywhere.
subjects.UNIT:RAIDER: Subject: Raider, a chunky cute light horseman with a very big head (about half of his own height) riding a small round short-legged pony seen from the front-right: the pony is sandy yellow with a cream mane and tail and dark grey hooves; the rider wears a big bright red hooded riding cloak over his head, shoulders and back that drapes over the pony's back, and a bright red saddle blanket; he holds a short light steel hand axe raised in the right hand; no helmet, no shield, no lance. Simple shapes and very few details; the pony's hooves are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a small fast rider, not a knight.
subjects.UNIT:GUARD: Subject: Guard, a chunky cute heavy spearman with a very big head (about half of the figure's height) and a tiny sturdy body in a wide braced stance: a heavy round light steel-grey helmet with a wide brim and a nose guard, a huge tall rectangular tower shield painted solid bright red with a thick light steel border held in front of the body on the left arm, covering him from chin to shins, and a long spear with a pale yellow wooden shaft and a light steel point held upright in the right hand, the point high above the helmet; light grey gloves, dark slate-grey boots; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a wall of shield, not a sword fighter.
subjects.UNIT:CAPTAIN: Subject: Captain, a chunky cute medieval army officer with a very big head (about half of the figure's height) and a tiny sturdy body: a soft round bright red medieval cap with a big white feather, a friendly face with a small moustache, a bright red long coat-tunic with a cream sash, holding a tall pale yellow wooden banner pole upright in the left hand with a big square bright red banner flag flying above his head, and a small cream-white hunting horn on a strap at his hip; dark slate-grey boots; no shield, no helmet, no bow; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a commander with a flag.
subjects.UNIT:CATAPULT: Subject: Catapult, a chunky cute wooden siege catapult (a medieval mangonel) on four chunky wheels, built of pale yellow-tan wood with light steel bands, its long throwing arm raised with a sling bucket holding a round grey stone, a big bright red cloth pennant flying from the top of the frame and a bright red cloth draped over the frame, with one small chunky crew man with a very big head in a bright red tunic and a steel cap standing beside it; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels and the crew man's feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a war machine, bigger than a soldier.
subjects.UNIT:KNIGHT: Subject: Knight, a chunky cute armoured knight with a very big head riding a big sturdy white warhorse seen from the front-right: a round light steel great helm with a visor slit and a big bright red plume, a light steel breastplate over chainmail, a long pale yellow wooden lance with a light steel point held upright and slightly forward, the horse covered in a big bright red cloth barding (caparison) from its neck to its knees with a cream trim, light steel chanfron on the horse's head, dark grey hooves; simple shapes and very few details; the horse's hooves are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a heavy mounted knight, bigger and heavier than a small pony rider.
subjects.UNIT:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Juggernaut, a chunky cute giant armoured brute, a huge hulking warrior much wider and taller than a normal soldier, with a big round head in a plain light steel bucket helmet with a visor slit, massive rounded light steel shoulder pauldrons, huge light steel gauntlets, a huge light steel warhammer with a pale yellow wooden handle held in both hands across the body, a big bright red tabard over a barrel chest and belly, chainmail sleeves, thick legs in dark slate-grey boots, wide braced stance; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a giant, not a normal soldier.
